errors.evidence: The Gini coefficient measures income inequality, not income equality. While this is a common colloquial phrasing, it is technically incorrect in an economic context.
The machine-generated description states the highest value is 44.8, but the highest value shown on the chart is 44.1 for the category 'Bulgaria (before social transfers)' in 2019.

errors.text_span: Всяка група стълбове е подредена по години
errors.evidence: This phrasing is awkward. The groups of bars represent the years, and it is the years (and thus the groups) that are ordered chronologically on the x-axis. A clearer phrasing would be 'The groups of bars are arranged by year'.
